scenes.text: The Mars crew went quiet for six minutes.
scenes.art_prompt: a lone deep-space probe drifting in black void, faint distant Earth, cinematic wide shot

scenes.text: Every system logged it. Every camera missed it.
scenes.art_prompt: a cold dim mission control room at night, one glowing monitor, empty chairs, blue screen light

scenes.text: They woke up on schedule, in the right seats, wearing the right suits.
scenes.art_prompt: an empty holographic star map with unmapped coordinates over darkness, ominous

scenes.text: But all four of them were soaking wet.
scenes.art_prompt: a radio telescope dish under a vast starry night sky, faint signal glow, eerie

scenes.text: There has never been liquid water on that part of Mars.
scenes.art_prompt: an ageing launch facility at dawn, rocket on the pad, nostalgic haze, wide establishing shot

scenes.text: Follow Deep Space Logs for the next entry.
scenes.art_prompt: a silent probe silhouette against a vast nebula, stars, quiet and final
